pages.text: Three mods reshape the Overworld itself, so the land and caves differ from vanilla before any structure is placed. They are invisible in the inventory: you meet them as scenery.

pages.title: Terralith
pages.text: Almost 100 new biomes in a realistic-to-light-fantasy style. It uses only vanilla blocks.

pages.title: Tectonic
pages.text: Rewrites terrain shaping: taller, grander and more varied land. It works alongside Terralith.

pages.title: YUNG's Better Caves
pages.text: A full overhaul of cave generation. Caves look different at every depth.

These change where things are, so check $(l:materials/ore_guide)the Ore Guide$(/l) before assuming vanilla heights. Ocean depth also matters for $(l:ocean/submarines)submarines$(/l): bigger terrain means more places to dive.
Lithostitched and Noisium are libraries used by some of these mods; they have no content of their own. Underground biomes with their own rules are in $(l:exploration/alexs_caves)Alex's Caves$(/l).
